chu_de: CHI THI #6 (sua #5): bot cu khong con gi + toi nay lam o nha
noi_dung:
SUA #5: chu du an noi 03/10 chieu "bot cu khong con gi dau, toi cung chua chay bao gio" -> BigMouse / DCA Am Duong / BlackDragon KHONG co tai khoan hay lich su lenh nao. BO buoc hoi so tai khoan / mat khau investor va KHONG quet Windows.old / o dia cho ba bot nay (tai_lieu/BOT_CU_LOGIC.md da cap nhat). Phan con lai cua #5 (b link them / link / chay, thu-muc, CDP) GIU NGUYEN; con mau 2196457 van uu tien 1.
MOI: chu du an muon DE DANH TOKEN va lam tiep TOI NAY o may nha. Truoc het: git pull -> b tiep (khoi TAY: muc "TOI 03/10 O NHA" + quyet dinh moi 03/10 chieu) -> b cau lay -> b cau chay (don trong viec/cho). Roi: b may (+ b may do --nhanh khi may ranh) -> b mang neu mql5 khong vao duoc -> don link-tham-do-con-mau. Bao cao cho chu du an 3-8 dong loi thuong: xong / chua / ket o dau / can chu du an lam gi.
Chu du an se tu hoi cau chon LLM (Qwen Code + Qwen 3.8 hay DeepSeek Harness + DeepSeek V4, API re o home.ai-box.vn/docs) o phien nha: cloud khong vao duoc docs; so lieu cloud da tra nam o tai_lieu/SO_SANH_LLM.md muc "03/10 chieu" - doc truoc, dung tim lai tu dau, khong dan khoa vao chat / thu.
